items.title: Coherent Is Up 21% in a Year as AI Goes “From Copper to Optical.” Is It a Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent stock is up 21% in the past year, but it’s about 56% below the peak it set in June, a run helped by Nvidia’s $2 billion investment. Revenue rose 50% in the September quarter, management now expects fiscal 2027 pro forma revenue growth above 60%, and it signed a PhotonLink deal valued at about $20 billion.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Says AI Demand Will Outrun Its Capacity Through 2027
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics is sold out of 1.6T transceivers, signed a hyperscaler deal worth up to $1.5 billion, and still guided below Wall Street. Is the capacity crunch a growth engine or the excuse behind another letdown?

items.title: Coherent Stock Fell 8% in a Week. J.P. Morgan Sees 100% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent (COHR) stock fell 8% during the week ended November 6, closing at $193 despite a sharp Friday rebound. Marvell Technology (MRVL) agreed to acquire Lumentum (LITE) in a $115 billion all-stock deal, potentially strengthening competition in AI optical connectivity.

items.title: Coherent Surges 13% as Investors Revisit $20 Billion AI Deal After Sell-Off; Lumentum Climbs 4%, Applied Optoelectronics Gains 3%
items.summary: Coherent beat estimates, then got hammered anyway. Now a rival's stock-swap merger has left it as the last independent laser maker standing, and traders are asking whether that independence is worth the price of its cash burn.

items.title: Coherent Soars 13% as Citi Lifts Target to $440, Lumentum Up 3% in AI Optics Rebound
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent jumped 13% today after Citi raised its target to $440, and Lumentum and Marvell bounced too. Wall Street is split on Coherent’s quarter: Citi and Stifel raised their targets, while BofA and others cut theirs.
